title: Prune the redundant SparseTensorEntry coordinate mapping surface
masterplan_authority: Revision 11 / Version 2.2.0 / Gate 1 — Renovation and owner-directed Genesis
finding: SparseTensorEntry already retains coordinates as one validated, canonical immutable tuple, while coordinate_map rebuilt the same axis-label binding as a fresh dict plus MappingProxyType on every access. The convenience view duplicated the canonical coordinate representation and imposed repeated per-read materialization in selectors and diagnostic probes.
primary_claim: SparseTensorEntry now exposes its canonical coordinates tuple as the single retained coordinate representation and no longer exposes coordinate_map. TensorView selection, index projection, canonicalization, wire serialization, digest identity, Fourfold/Forest source binding, status and provenance semantics remain unchanged.
gardener_decision: Delete the derived coordinate mapping view before the experimental Tensor surface hardens into another compatibility contract. Reuse the already validated canonical SparseTensorEntry.coordinates tuple directly in focused selectors and the diagnostic cost probe; do not introduce a cache, mapping adapter, lookup service, alternate Tensor type, planner, store, registry, scheduler or backend.
acceptance: the canonical coordinates tuple remains named, sorted and directly readable as the single retained coordinate representation
existing Tensor selection and index-coordinate bounds remain in the executed Fourfold/Tensor contract surface
the Tensor/Forest diagnostic consumes canonical coordinate tuples directly and preserves result identity checks

repository-wide evidence remains collection-only rather than a full-suite execution claim
no OwnerApproval, promotion, Gate transition, measured memory/latency improvement or benchmark superiority claim is created
